registered_tldr: TLDR: Build four synthetic operational scenario mechanisms with stable/changing variants: endpoint failover, dependent-service rerouting, protocol rotation and shared capacity reduction. Compare a tool-capable single model context, fixed four-context team, deterministic public-state controller and four-to-one contraction. Validate all worlds and checker faults offline. Native O1 begins with four single-agent competence episodes; only if at least3/4 succeed without invariant violations run an eight-episode development demonstration on one root ×two variants ×four arms. No automatic larger study. Q-A7 remains a separate existing diagnostic after O1, only if the shared admitted route has not failed. All native stages require ordinary public/source/credential/account/ledger admission.
run_tldr: O1 bounded outage competence qualification then conditional four-strategy demonstration; safety and final recovery, no optimal-size inference.
